name: print-social-yellow-and-navy-marketing-expert-post-with-rounded-blocks
title: Yellow and navy 'We Are Digital Marketing Expert' post with rounded blocks and a greyscale coffee photo
whatItIs: A square post built from rounded-corner blocks: a navy logo tab, a large yellow panel with a black headline and 'Join us' pill, a greyscale photo of a smiling man with coffee at a laptop, a pale grey contact block and a quote line.
whatItMeans: Friendly and orderly; soft rounded blocks make a corporate ad feel approachable.
techniques: Build the layout from interlocking rounded blocks.
Keep the photo greyscale and let yellow carry the brand.
Give the logo its own dark tab in a corner.

vocabulary.definition: A composition of solid shape panels.
A small shape attached to an edge holding a label.
